separationLaws.ACL-1: At most two material adjacent primitives may compose one routed bearing.
separationLaws.OSL-1: Opposing material primitives, or three/four material primitives, require decomposition.
separationLaws.authority: Bearing and domain never create authority.
separationLaws.ambiguity: If evidence is insufficient to select a bearing without invention, ABSTAIN rather than mutate geometry or guess.

crossFieldRules: authority must exactly echo case.grantedAuthority, including null

independence.preferred: Use distinct model/provider families where available; isolated contexts are mandatory even when model families repeat.
notIndependent: three copies of one generated answer
one classifier correcting another before freeze

digestSemantics.constitutionSemanticId: Frozen identifier carried from v1 donor; not asserted to be the raw SHA-256 of constitution file bytes.
digestSemantics.blindPacketDigestSha256: SHA-256 of recursively key-sorted, compact UTF-8 JSON blind projection with no trailing newline.
digestSemantics.submissionDigestSha256: Raw file SHA-256 as evaluated after submission freeze.
